IN PHOTOS: PASAY CITY, PHILIPPINES — Activists stage a protest in front of the Japanese Embassy on April 30, 2026, denouncing Japan’s continued support for fossil fuel initiatives and military expansion across the Asia-Pacific. Advocacy groups criticize programs such as “POWERR Asia” and “AZEC,” warning that these deepen regional energy dependence and benefit large corporations at the expense of climate action, while calling for a just transition to community-led renewable energy and an end to militarization.

📸 Edd Castro
